g.text: RF can power U7 while main3.3V is absent. VOUT isolation alone does not bound signal backfeed.

g.text: Five TMUX1511 channels interrupt CS/SCK/MOSI/MISO/IRQ on reset and main-power loss.

g.desc: Five TMUX1511 channels interrupt CS/SCK/MOSI/MISO/IRQ on reset and main-power loss.

g.text: Host pullups remain main-side; RF-side CS high and SCK/MOSI low have local passive defaults.

g.text: The3.6V off-terminal rating is a LIMIT; excessive RF, faults, negative transients and ramps need tests.

g.text: R69 uses a20uA aggregate off-feed allocation, not an assumed guarantee from the FM11 brief.

g.text: No security service is enabled by RF field, IRQ or reset release. Production Root still required.
